file(GLOB DHW_QT_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cpp")

qt_standard_project_setup()

# Windows icon and version resource. Kept strictly to MSVC: MinGW and non-Windows
# toolchains do not need it. assets/app.ico is generated by tools/make_icon and
# committed, so a clean checkout builds without Qt tooling.
set(DHW_APP_RESOURCE_SOURCES "")
set(DHW_APP_RESOURCE_INCLUDES "")
if(MSVC AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/app.rc")
    set(DHW_APP_ICON "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/assets/app.ico")
    if(EXISTS "${DHW_APP_ICON}")
        enable_language(RC)
        list(APPEND DHW_APP_RESOURCE_SOURCES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/app.rc")
        # app.rc refers to "app.ico"; rc.exe searches include directories.
        set(DHW_APP_RESOURCE_INCLUDES "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/assets")
    else()
        message(WARNING "assets/app.ico is missing; DaHoWork.exe will be built without an icon")
    endif()
endif()

qt_add_executable(dhw_app ${DHW_QT_SOURCES} ${DHW_APP_RESOURCE_SOURCES})
target_link_libraries(dhw_app PRIVATE dhw_core dhw_render_qt Qt6::Widgets)

# Opt-in Fluent (WinUI 3) widget skin. The vendored library is only a build
# dependency of this executable; the presentation canvas never sees it.
if(DHW_UI_FLUENT)
    if(NOT TARGET FluentQt::FluentQt)
        message(FATAL_ERROR "DHW_UI_FLUENT=ON but the FluentQt::FluentQt target is missing")
    endif()
    target_link_libraries(dhw_app PRIVATE FluentQt::FluentQt)
    target_compile_definitions(dhw_app PRIVATE DHW_UI_FLUENT=1)
    # Charge the vendored headers to the third party, not to us: clang then keeps its
    # deprecation diagnostics (Q_OS_MAC in the 1.10.1 compatibility shims) out of a
    # build that must stay at zero warnings.
    target_include_directories(dhw_app SYSTEM PRIVATE
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/fluentqt/include"
        "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party/fluentqt/src")
endif()
if(DHW_APP_RESOURCE_INCLUDES)
    target_include_directories(dhw_app PRIVATE "${DHW_APP_RESOURCE_INCLUDES}")
endif()
dhw_set_warnings(dhw_app)

set_target_properties(dhw_app PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME "DaHoWork"
    MACOSX_BUNDLE OFF
    WIN32_EXECUTABLE ON
)
